main.description: Report the content classifier's operational metrics, derived from its tables at read time: current job counts by status, every recorded day of model usage, the worker lag, the number of undelivered community NSFW flag events and score alerts, and whether the worker is paused on a refused API token. Admin identity comes from the authenticated service context, never request fields.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: Authentication is required; authenticate with an instance administrator's service account before retrying.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The authenticated actor is not an instance administrator; do not retry.

usage.description: Every recorded usage row, newest day first, then by model

workerLagSeconds.description: Whole seconds since the oldest due pending job became due; 0 when no pending job is due. With the classifier enabled, only jobs under the current policy version and models count; with it disabled, every pending job counts

undeliveredFlagEvents.description: Community NSFW flag events not yet delivered, including those that exhausted their attempts

undeliveredScoreAlerts.description: Classifier score alerts not yet delivered, including those that exhausted their attempts

authPausedUntil.description: Present while the worker is paused because Cloudflare refused the API token (HTTP 401 or 403): when the pause ends. The pause starts at 5 minutes and doubles, up to 1 hour, while the token keeps being refused; jobs wait and spend no attempt

jobCounts.description: Current classification job counts by status. With the classifier enabled, queued, deferred and retrying count only jobs under the current policy version and models; with it disabled, every pending job. The other counts cover every policy version and model

deferred.description: Jobs whose subject awaits community acceptance

retrying.description: Jobs waiting to retry after a failed attempt

sent.description: Jobs classified with a stored result

closedSuperseded.description: Jobs closed because a newer version of the subject replaced them

closedNotVisible.description: Jobs closed because the subject was no longer visible

usageDay.description: One model's usage on one UTC day
